Book a call

What "posts per week" means

Fully written LinkedIn posts in your tone of voice, including a visual where needed. You approve them, we schedule them. We replace rejected posts at no extra cost.

What "track competitors" means

We ask the same questions for them as for you and see when they win and you do not. That determines which content we create for you. You choose who we track.

What is not in the monthly price

A setup fee of €195, paid once, for the onboarding call, baseline measurement and setup. Also: advertising (we do not do it), a new website if you do not have one (separate proposal via IQ Script) and photography or video. Everything that is listed is included.

Measured in ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity and Google. Published in your CMS and on LinkedIn.
